card.title: Follow-ups
card.sub: Who has not replied in 5 days or more, and how logging the next action clears them.
card.foot: Demo mode: every company, person and email here is made up, and nothing is saved.

scenes.caption: Follow-ups lists everyone we reached out to who has not replied in 5 days or more. Check it every day.
Example Data Lab: we sent the draft agreement on 8 November, and there has been no reply for 15 days.
Say Bruno has just called back. Log the follow-up opens the company on Log an action.
A call, they replied, Bruno Teixeira, and one line on what happened.
Show what will be written shows the file. Then Write it.
Back on Follow-ups, Example Data Lab has gone: a logged reply clears it.
Example Security: our email on their question about pricing, 9 days without a reply. This time we chase them.
We chase by email: an email, we reached out, to Hugo Brandt.
Example Security leaves Follow-ups too. Our new email restarts the clock: if they stay quiet, it comes back in 5 days.
Next: writing an email, and signing it off.
